notes.title: Ascension update!
notes.notes:
After many requests ascension is now implemented! It's an early version so I'll be tweaking and fixing bugs over the week so make sure to report them to the support email! 
The ascension update means you can reset your game progress to permanently upgrade your chickens on that save! This allows you to upgrade your chickens so even roadkill can lay $99 eggs! It even has different effects on special chickens! 
To purchase the upgrades you'll need golden eggs which are a low chance drop from chickens. 

Thanks for playing and happy holidays! ːhappymeatː JB - Jakal Studios.

Support email: jackbruce101@gmail.com

[url=https://discord.gg/uYmuQCj]Discord if you wanna chat[/url]

notes.title: Crash and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Updated to fix 30 minute crash bug which was caused by the game reaching the end of its music cycle.
Fixed Backgrounds not being saved.

If you are experiencing errors with saves being lost I have not heard about it before release, please reply to this post with a paste of the crash error(if applicable) and steps to reproduce the error. 

There is also now a play button on the storepage for those who were unable to play because of this I'm sorry but it was out of my hands! I tried to do a bunch of things but it turns out it was Steam's fault and I am quite mad at them. Apologies again!

Also I will be starting a competition soon allowing people to send me ideas for chickens to be added to the game with prizes on steam! So start brainstorming ideas and your chicken could be added!
